business_problem: BBVA needed a secure, governed way to embed AI across a global bank so customer experiences, risk analysis, operations, and employee productivity could all improve without sacrificing regulatory discipline.
solution_summary: BBVA moved from an initial ChatGPT Enterprise pilot to a strategic alliance with OpenAI centered on "The Eight," its roadmap for redesigning banking end to end. The bank first proved secure employee adoption with a deployment to 3,000 users, then expanded access to more than 100,000 employees across legal, risk, engineering, operations, finance, marketing, and customer service under shared governance built by security, legal, compliance, and technology teams. On top of the enterprise workspace, employees created more than 20,000 custom GPTs, including Credit Analysis Pro GPT for unstructured risk signals, a Retail Banking Legal Assistant GPT for branch inquiries, and a Client Experience Assistant GPT for survey analysis. BBVA also created AI champions and "wizards" to spread hands-on expertise, turning AI from a point tool into a coordinated operating layer that helps the bank anticipate client needs, accelerate internal decisions, and scale knowledge across regions.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides the secure enterprise-wide workspace used across regulated banking functions.

solution_components.name: Credit Analysis Pro GPT
solution_components.role: Automates extraction and analysis of unstructured data for credit-risk assessments.

solution_components.name: Retail Banking Legal Assistant GPT
solution_components.role: Drafts responses to high-volume legal inquiries from branch managers using internal sources.

solution_components.name: Client Experience Assistant GPT
solution_components.role: Analyzes open-ended survey feedback and recommends customer-experience actions at scale.

data_flow: Employees submit legal, risk, customer-service, and operational tasks into ChatGPT Enterprise and department-specific GPTs. Those tools draw on internal knowledge sources and unstructured documents, then return reviewed outputs within BBVA's governance framework so insights and decisions can scale across markets.
business_outcome: BBVA achieved large-scale employee adoption, measurable time savings, major efficiency gains in selected workflows, and a bank-wide structure for turning AI into proactive customer, risk, and operational capabilities rather than isolated experiments.
metrics: ~3 hours saved per employee per week

Custom GPTs are used for risk, legal, client-experience, and internal decision workflows
